edge_explainer: The screen premise - that a -60% drawdown in a 72%-gross-margin animal-health duopolist must be an over-punished quality compounder - is refuted by the peer tape. Over the same 52 weeks and the same soft pet end-market, Elanco (the direct competitor in the exact two contested categories, dermatology and parasiticides) grew revenue +10.5% and its equity rose 85% to within 7% of its high, while Zoetis grew 0% organic and fell 48%. IDEXX, the clean vet-visit-volume proxy, fell only 14%, sizing the honest end-market drag at roughly a quarter of Zoetis's move. Zoetis's own Q1'26 release leads with 'pet owners demonstrated increased price sensitivity, resulting in a decline in veterinary visits' - a macro framing - and only secondarily names competition. That is the takeaway-vs-data divergence: a share-loss problem marketed as a cycle. Two further masking layers sit under the headline. First, the reported 'flat organic growth' includes a disclosed but non-headline $100M Fiscal-Year-Alignment calendar pull-in worth +4.4pp, so clean organic revenue was about -4.4%; and because both components were one-time pull-ins into Q1, the FY26 guide of +2-5% organic requires Q2-Q4 to run +2.7-6.7% clean off a US companion-animal base that just printed -11%. Second, adjusted EPS grew 9% while adjusted net income grew 2% - seven of the nine points are a 5.7% share-count reduction, funded by $3.8B of new 2025 debt including $2.0B of 0.25% converts at a $148.20 strike plus $187M of capped calls capped at $211.72, all deployed into buybacks around $115 that are now marked at $77. That is roughly $780M of shareholder capital destroyed in seven months and it is direct evidence against underwriting management's forward algorithm. The ruling is derailment, not de-rate: estimates are falling and the multiple is following, with the multiple merely running ahead. At E[FV] $78.80 against $77.10 the residual edge is 2.2% - the market has already made the share-transfer call correctly, and the surviving observation is the multiple inversion the street has not digested, with Elanco growing 10.5% at 23.7x forward and Zoetis growing 0% at 11.2x. Mechanism for the knowledge graph: masking channel = macro-attribution of a competitive loss, plus a non-recurring reporting-calendar pull-in embedded inside a non-GAAP 'organic' measure that does not exclude it; signal channel = the direct competitor's revenue growth gap plus a pure end-market volume proxy, which together decompose the drawdown into cycle versus share; signal-to-price latency = none, this one is already fully in the price, which is precisely why the finding produces a REJECT rather than a short.
